scene: An old weaver weaves humming copper reeds into a bell-shaped basket.
picture: Flat side-view along sunny turf. On the far left, a bundle of shining reeds rests beside the cross-legged weaver. Left of centre, the boy in orange vest and scarf watches her work. At centre sits an unfolded parchment map pinned to a stand. On the far right stands a tall wooden mooring tower with ladder.
shown: A bundle of stiff copper reeds sticking out on the far left
An unfolded parchment map pegged to a wicker stand on the centre
A wooden ladder leading up a tall mooring tower on the far right
